name: UCLouvain (Université catholique de Louvain)
summary: French-speaking university in Louvain-la-Neuve; bachelor's in French, plus one English business engineering degree with KU Leuven in Brussels.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is automatically recognised. French-taught bachelor's need proof of French (DELF, DALF, TCF) if you weren't schooled in French; Medicine and Dentistry need the ARES entrance exam.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Business Engineering
programmes.about: Finance, accounting, marketing, logistics and HR on a strong base of maths, statistics, data analysis and modelling, plus at least one other language; a joint degree taught at UCLouvain Saint-Louis and KU Leuven in central Brussels.
programmes.ib: Joint degree with KU Leuven: you apply on KU Leuven's platform and meet its rules (free online maths test; Maths AA HL strongly advised).
programmes.selectionNote: You apply on KU Leuven's platform, not UCLouvain's. Every applicant takes the faculty's free online maths test; admission is at the faculty's discretion on your file.

notes: Several Saint-Louis Brussels bachelor's are bilingual French-English or French-English-Dutch, so they still need French.
For 2026-27, EU citizens entering with an IB could apply until 30 September; the 2027 dates are not yet published.
Veterinary medicine, physiotherapy, speech therapy and psychology and education cap places for non-residents of Belgium.
